about_the_game:
I wither away slowly in a cage.

They feast at the table, toasting my death.

She left thirteen boxes, each demanding a life as the key.

Waiting for you, hunting each other on trial land.

—Welcome to this revenge feast that has been brewing for six years.

The gears of fate begin to turn from this moment!

Background

In 2020, a fatal case triggered by school bullying shocked society. A 17-year-old girl was confined in a cage and eventually died of dehydration. Three main perpetrators received lenient sentences due to their age, while the other 14 involved individuals escaped legal punishment for insufficient evidence.

Six years later, the released perpetrators meet mysterious deaths, and the 14 accomplices unexpectedly gathered in the same barren land. Despite diverse backgrounds, some strangers until now have never met before. Their only connection is the haunting past of that bullying incident...

On this barren land, the fates of the fourteen intertwine, each harboring dark secrets. You will join in this "Trial Game," struggling with every decision. Will you cross any line to survive, or atone for past sins? Choose between betrayal and trust, kill or redemption!

Features

  • Life-for-Boxes Survival Mechanism

    Thirteen locked supply crates. Every death is a key. Resources—water, survival tools, and even hidden truths—can only be obtained through bloodshed.Are you ready to survive by killing?

  • Immersive Interactive Gameplay

    Exploration, deduction, QTE, surveillance hacking, puzzle-solving......Every action and choice plunges you deeper into the role.This is not just passive viewing—it’s a personal descent into the "trial."

  • Cinematic Audio-Visual Experience

    Set on a realistically rendered dangerous land, stealth and escape are constant companions. Every breath, every decision, pushes characters toward different fates.Experience the "torture of humanity" in bone-chilling despair.

  • Multi-Perspective Narrative

    Break free from linear storytelling. You will play as multiple characters: the "Bystander" spying from the shadows, the "Insider" trapped in the crisis, or the "Judge" wielding the scythe of justice. Piece together the truth across perspectives to reveal the complete story.

  • The Intertwined Butterfly Effect

    Unlike traditional multi-branch narratives, a casual choice in Character A might fundamentally alter Character B's story telling. Achieve vengeance? Escape alone? Or all perish? Every decision you make acts like a domino, triggering a chain reaction in everyone's destiny.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains some violence, blood, killing, and a small amount of nudity, and is not suitable for all players.

short_description: Killing Game of the Thirsty is an interactive cinematic game, blending revenge and battle royale genres. 14 people are stranded on a barren land, where the only way to get water is by taking lives. Survive this deadly game: cooperate or betray? Seek redemption or become the killer?
supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Korean
*languages with full audio support
